tickets.title: Fix StateNotifierMixin missing disposed guard (systemic — affects ~20 ViewModels)
tickets.description:
## Finding

`StateNotifierMixin.setLoading()`, `setError()`, `setSuccess()`, and `clearError()` all call `notifyListeners()` unconditionally — no disposed check. Any ViewModel using this mixin (and not extending `BaseViewModel` which has its own guard) can fire `notifyListeners()` after disposal from async callbacks.

**Root cause:** `state_notifier_mixin.dart:91-116` — four methods call `notifyListeners()` without checking a disposed flag.

**Affected ViewModels (~20):** All VMs using `StateNotifierMixin` directly on `ChangeNotifier` without a local `_isDisposed` guard, including:
- `RecipeFormAutoSaveManager` — Timer callback calls `notifyListeners()` after dispose (line 167)
- `SocialCommentsManager` — stream `onError` handler fires after dispose (line 103)
- `SocialGroupDetailViewModel` — event bus callbacks (lines 171, 186)
- `RecipeListViewModel._loadViewModePreference` — async pref load (line 135)
- `PersonalTagViewModel` — `setError` from stream onError bypasses local `_safeNotifyListeners` (line 166)
- `FriendsViewModel`, `GroupContentViewModel`, `GroupDetailViewModel`, `AccountSecurityViewModel`, `AddMembersToGroupViewModel`, `CreateGroupConversationViewModel`

Additionally, `StateNotifierMixin.dispose()` calls `clearState()` which calls `notifyListeners()` — a spurious final notification during disposal (line 265-270).

## Why It Matters

`notifyListeners()` on a disposed `ChangeNotifier` throws `FlutterError` in debug mode. In release mode it fires stale listener callbacks. This is the most widespread lifecycle bug in the codebase — every async operation in any affected ViewModel is a potential trigger.

## Suggested Fix

Add a `_isDisposed` flag to `StateNotifierMixin` and check it in all four notification methods. Remove the `clearState()` call from `dispose()`. This single fix protects all ~20 ViewModels at once.

tickets.title: Add batch chunking to 15+ unguarded Firestore batch operations
tickets.description:
## Finding

15+ Firestore batch operations accumulate writes into a single batch without checking the 500-operation limit. Any of these will throw a Firestore error if the collection grows large enough.

**Locations:**

| File | Method | Risk |
|------|--------|------|
| `content_deletion_operations.dart:12-40` | `deleteRecipes()` — 2 collections in 1 batch | High |
| `profile_deletion_operations.dart:55-73` | `deleteActivityFeed()` | Medium |
| `profile_deletion_operations.dart:76-92` | `deleteFcmTokens()` | Low |
| `profile_deletion_operations.dart:115-133` | `deleteNotifications()` | Medium |
| `profile_deletion_operations.dart:136-155` | `deleteConsentRecords()` | Low |
| `firebase_audit_repository.dart:349-354` | `deleteOldAuditLogs()` | Medium |
| `firebase_report_repository.dart:85-95` | `deleteUserReports()` | Low |
| `parsing_correction_repository.dart:131-135` | `deleteUserCorrections()` | Low |
| `firebase_notifications_repository.dart:157-182` | `sendBulkNotifications()` | High |
| `firebase_notifications_repository.dart:238-265` | `markMultipleAsRead()` | High |
| `firebase_notifications_repository.dart:291-300` | `markAllAsRead()` | High |
| `message_mutation_module.dart:372-398` | `batchMarkAsDelivered()` | Medium |
| `friend_category_member_module.dart:110-163` | `addMembers()` — 2N+1 ops | Medium |
| `friend_category_member_module.dart:198-231` | `removeMembers()` — 2N+1 ops | Medium |
| `friend_category_member_module.dart:369-387` | `deleteAllCategoryMembers()` — 2N ops | Medium |

**Note:** `social_deletion_operations.dart` is already correct — uses `_commitIfNeeded` with 450-op margin.

## Why It Matters

Firestore silently rejects entire batches exceeding 500 operations. Account deletion (250+ recipes), bulk notifications (500+ recipients), and 'mark all read' (500+ unread) are realistic production scenarios.

## Suggested Fix

Extract a shared `_chunkedBatchCommit()` helper and apply to all locations. Chunk at 450 ops for safety margin.

tickets.title: Add input length limits and validation to 12+ forms and backend paths
tickets.description:
## Finding

Multiple user-facing text inputs and backend write paths accept unbounded input, risking Firestore document size limits (1 MB), memory pressure, and DoS via oversized content.

**No length limit at all (UI + backend):**

| Location | Field | Risk |
|----------|-------|------|
| `dynamic_list_builder.dart:45-55` | Ingredient, instruction, tag entries | High |
| `fran_sociala_medier_view.dart:231-248` | Text paste import field | High |
| `group_detail_view.dart:218-226` | Group name rename dialog | Medium |
| `chat_action_handler.dart:297-316` | Chat message edit dialog | Medium |

**Length limit at UI only, not backend:**
- `FormValidators.comment()`: 500 chars at UI, but `firebase_comments_repository.dart:150-155` only checks non-empty

**Image validation gap:**
- `messaging_media_service.dart:105-160`: `uploadAndSendImage()` never calls `validateImage()` — no file size check
- `firebase_storage_repository.dart:558-574`: `isValidImageFile()` checks extension only, not MIME magic bytes

## Suggested Fix

1. Add `maxLength` to all `TextField`/`TextFormField` widgets
2. Add length validation in repository write methods as defense-in-depth
3. Call `validateImage()` in the messaging upload path
4. Add MIME magic bytes check to `isValidImageFile()`

tickets.title: Fix Firestore write safety: non-atomic sharing + comment like race condition
tickets.description:
## Finding

### 1. Non-atomic social sharing writes (2 locations)

`social_menu_operations.dart:88-113` and `shopping_social_share_module.dart:71-97`: Main shared doc written standalone, then per-friend records in a separate batch. App crash between writes = orphaned document with zero share records.

**Fix:** Move the main doc `.set()` into the same batch.

### 2. Optimistic concurrency in comment like toggle

`firebase_comments_repository.dart:307-331`: reads like doc outside transaction, writes based on stale read. Two concurrent toggles = double-like and double-incremented `likesCount`.

**Fix:** Wrap in `runTransaction()` — read inside transaction callback.

tickets.title: Fix uncancellable async retry and polling patterns across 6 locations
tickets.description:
## Finding

6 locations use fire-and-forget async, recursive retries, or polling loops that cannot be cancelled on disposal.

1. **`personal_recipe_module.dart:724-808`**: Fire-and-forget `Future.microtask()` + retry via `Future.delayed()`. Under logout+relogin, pending sync can write previous user's data.
2. **`chat_viewmodel.dart:314-324`**: Recursive `Future.delayed(500ms)` with no max depth. If `_conversation` never loads, runs forever.
3. **`personal_tag_viewmodel.dart:120-154`**: Recursive retry with `setLoading(false)` in `finally` firing on every frame — loading flicker.
4. **`image_upload_validator.dart:69-96`**: `while(true)` polls every 500ms for up to 2 minutes. No cancellation on dispose.
5. **`pea_loading_animation.dart:71-83`**: Recursive `Future.delayed` — cannot be cancelled, keeps State alive.
6. **`animated_list_item.dart:121-125`**: Same pattern, accumulates in high-churn lists.

## Suggested Fix

Store `Timer` references, cancel in `dispose()`. Convert recursive retries to iterative loops with `_isDisposed` checks. Add max retry caps.

tickets.title: Fix HTTP Client leak in OcrExtractionService (new client per call)
tickets.description:
## Finding

`ocr_extraction_service.dart:195-198`: `_httpClient` getter creates a new `http.Client()` on every access. Never closed. DI registers a singleton `http.Client` but this service bypasses it.

Each leaked client holds ~6 socket connections. Batch OCR import of 10 images = ~60 leaked sockets.

## Suggested Fix

Inject the singleton `http.Client` from DI via constructor, or store a single `_client` field and close in `dispose()`.

tickets.title: Add cacheWidth/cacheHeight to network images on recipe detail and fullscreen
tickets.description:
## Finding

Several `Image.network()` and `CachedNetworkImage` usages decode at full resolution without `cacheWidth`/`cacheHeight`.

**Locations:**
- `recipe_detail_view.dart:184` — hero image
- `fullscreen_image_viewer.dart:108` — 4x zoom InteractiveViewer
- `profile_menu.dart:327` — avatar
- Several sharing dialogs

Contrast: `image_components.dart` and `optimized_image_loader.dart` do set these correctly.

Each open adds ~3-15 MB to Flutter ImageCache. 10 recipe pages = 30-150 MB.

## Suggested Fix

Add `cacheWidth`/`memCacheWidth` sized to display width. Or route through `optimized_image_loader.dart`.

tickets.title: Add size caps to 4 unbounded in-memory caches
tickets.description:
## Finding

4 caches grow without bound:

1. `UserService._profileCache` (user_service.dart:43) — grows with searches, ~2KB/entry
2. `FriendsProfileCacheManager._requestUserProfiles` (friends_profile_cache_manager.dart:15)
3. `SiteConfigRepository._cache` (site_config_repository.dart:17) — has TTL but no size cap
4. `AsyncOperationMixin._executionTimes` (async_operation_mixin.dart:360) — static, never cleared

Bonus: `IntelligentCacheManager._currentMemoryUsage` underestimates because `_userCache` entries aren't counted.

## Suggested Fix

Add size cap (~200 entries) with LRU/FIFO eviction. Clear `_executionTimes` entries older than throttle duration.

tickets.title: Fix ReDoS vulnerability in FormValidators._urlRegex
tickets.description:
## Finding

`form_validators.dart:67-69`: URL regex has catastrophic backtracking. The `\b` word boundary + `([-a-zA-Z0-9()@:%_\+.~#?&//=]*)$` creates NFA ambiguity. Input of ~40 chars with trailing invalid char freezes UI isolate for seconds.

Triggered on every keystroke in recipe source URL field (`edit_recipe_view.dart`, `skriv_sjalv_recept_view.dart`).

## Suggested Fix

Replace with `Uri.tryParse()` or a non-backtracking regex.

tickets.title: Fix error propagation: repositories swallow errors + stale VM error state
tickets.description:
## Finding

### Repository methods return valid-looking values on error

`firebase_recipe_repository.dart`:
- `renamePersonalTagInRecipes()` (line 488-546): returns `0` on error — same as 'no recipes updated'
- `countRecipesByTagId()` (line 400-410): returns `0` on error — same as 'no recipes'
- `canRead/canWrite/canDelete()` (lines 757-831): return `false` on network timeout — looks like 'no permission'

### Stale error state
`realtime_menu_viewmodel.dart:133-290`: 7 mutation methods set error on failure but never clear it on success. Error banner persists across subsequent successful operations.

### Pagination without timeout
`firebase_recipe_repository.dart:674-702`: `while(true)` pagination with no `.timeout()` and no max-pages cap.

## Suggested Fix

1. Throw or return `Result<T>` from repository methods
2. Add `clearError()` on success in RealtimeMenuViewModel
3. Add `.timeout()` and `maxPages` cap to pagination
